correctness.rationale: A four-dimensional section face has exactly two saturated ambient cube coordinates and is counted via one of forty three-faces, including degenerate transition parameters. Six coordinate pairs leave weights (1,1,s), levels 0,0,2,-2; four pairs involving x5 leave weights (1,1,1), levels abs(1+-s). Coarea for convolution of three uniform variables gives A_w=8||w||_2 f_w and the piecewise triangular slice integrals. Summing yields exactly the three stated expressions at s=2,4 with matching boundaries. Derivative factor after squaring is -3(s-1)(s^3+25s^2-21s+3), with spurious small root rejected by the unsquared sign condition, and strict lower bound >96 for finite s and limit 96 at infinity. Independently symbolically checked factorization and endpoint values. The exact-rational 18-point cube-face verifier was inspected but does not prove all s.
